findings.message: sensitive GitHub token permissions: contents:write, actions:write
findings.remediation: Grant write scopes only to the job that needs them and keep all other scopes read-only or none.
findings.impact: A compromised workflow step can modify repository content, packages, deployments, checks, or security records.
findings.attack_vector: A permissions block grants write access to a sensitive GITHUB_TOKEN scope.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: checkout without persist-credentials: false — tokens may leak
findings.remediation: Use persist-credentials: false when checking out external/untrusted repositories.
findings.impact: Checkout without persist-credentials: false leaves GITHUB_TOKEN in .git/config for any process to read.
findings.attack_vector: actions/checkout defaults to persist-credentials: true — token leaks via .git/config.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: workflow downloads remote scripts without integrity verification
findings.remediation: Add checksum/GPG verification for all downloaded artifacts.
findings.impact: Downloading scripts without integrity verification allows MITM substitution of malicious code.
findings.attack_vector: curl/wget in workflow without checksum/sha256 verification — attacker intercepts and replaces.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: contains 2 line(s) longer than 500 characters (possible minified/obfuscated code)
findings.remediation: Review extremely long lines; they may contain hidden logic.
findings.impact: Extremely long lines hide obfuscated or minified code from human review.
findings.attack_vector: Lines > 500 chars — code is structured to evade visual inspection.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: disables TLS verification or references plaintext HTTP transport (2 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Use HTTPS and keep TLS certificate verification enabled.
findings.impact: Disabling TLS verification or using plaintext HTTP allows MITM interception of all traffic.
findings.attack_vector: rejectUnauthorized: false or http:// URL — attacker can intercept/modify all requests.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: detects net.connect, dgram.createSocket, or process-level network access
findings.remediation: Review all network connections; ensure they use allowlisted destinations with explicit approval.
findings.impact: Raw TCP/UDP sockets bypass HTTP-level monitoring and allow covert data channels.
findings.attack_vector: net.connect() or dgram.createSocket() — traffic is invisible to HTTP-based DLP.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: accesses system or user credential stores (5 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Avoid direct access to credential files; use authenticated API flows instead.
findings.impact: Direct access to system credential stores allows theft of SSH keys, AWS creds, and Docker tokens.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
